analysis.summary: Accent Microcell Ltd hosted its earnings conference call on May 16, 2026, to discuss operational and financial performance for the half-year and full-year ended March 31, 2026. Management highlighted an increase in export revenues and higher sales of premium products like MCC Spheres and SMCC. The company provided updates on its Unit 3 expansion, addressing delays in Phase 1 due to regulatory approvals and monsoons, while outlining plans for subsequent phases. Demand remains supported by an order book of approximately 4,000 metric tons across domestic and export markets. Accent Microcell Limited presented its investor presentation for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

guidance.claim: Management expects the proportion of premium range products in revenue to be around 16% to 17% for FY27.
guidance.quote: Gradually, it is going to increase, but for H2 or for entire finance year 27, it's going to be, say, more or less 16 to 17%.

guidance.claim: Phase 1 at peak capacity is expected to generate revenue equal to roughly 40% of the existing revenue from Unit 1 and Unit 2.
guidance.quote: Sir, Phase 1, at a peak capacity, say, will fetch, revenue of around, roughly between, say, 40% of the, say, existing revenue that would be from Unit 1 and 2.

guidance.claim: Phase 2 is expected to achieve 75% to 80% capacity utilization from its first year of operation.
guidance.quote: Sir, Phase 2 will, say, have an, say, 75% to 80% of capacity residence from first year onwards.

guidance.claim: Accent Microcell projects ₹70 crore in revenue from Unit-III in Year 1.
The projected revenue mix for Unit-III is 60% exports and 40% domestic sales.
Management expects the company to achieve a 15% to 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
guidance.quote: at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

demand_outlook.claim: The current MCC demand outlook remains positive based on the existing order book.
demand_outlook.quote: So, currency, current, MCC demand outlook is good, taking into account our existing order book.

demand_outlook.claim: Export revenue share increased to roughly 63% compared to 53% in the prior year.
demand_outlook.quote: ODAC exports, it's roughly, say, around 63%, which was, 53% last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Accent Microcell derives 63.28% of its revenue from export markets and 36.72% from domestic markets.
demand_outlook.quote: 22,086.80 Lakhs (63.28%) of the Company’s Revenue comes from exports.

demand_outlook.claim: Product inquiries have increased following an operational disruption at a peer company's plant.
demand_outlook.quote: so, of course is, there has been product. Inquiry has been increased, and we have been taking care of the business from our business side.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects global demand growth for MCC to benefit by an additional 1.0% to 1.5% over the base growth rate.
demand_outlook.quote: So for current scenario, of course, as I mentioned earlier, that it's positive impact. By 1.1 point 5% extra.

demand_outlook.claim: Global demand for MCC is around 2,50,000 metric tons per annum while domestic Indian demand is around 50,000 metric tons per annum.
demand_outlook.quote: We have 2.5 lakh is globally 50,000 metric ton for the Indian market.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 will focus on premium excipient products, while Phase 2 will cater to MCC.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 will cater to, say, a premium range of excipient products, and Phase 2 will cater to MCC.

capex_expansion.claim: Land has been purchased to accommodate expansion plans up to Phase 6.
capex_expansion.quote: Good question Mr. Priyank, we have purchased land for till phase 6.

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 capacity will total 2,400 metric tons per annum across targeted premium excipient products.
capex_expansion.quote: Madam, we need to… read with, weighted average capacity, the capacity of, Unit 3, phase 1 is 2,400 metric ton per nm.

capex_expansion.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 is expected to be commercialized by late October or early November 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: By say, quarter 3 of the current financial year. So anywhere between, say by the end of October or in the 1st couple of weeks of November.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial runs for Phase 2 of Unit 3 are scheduled to begin in July 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Sir, trial run will commence from say, July 26, as I was stated earlier.

capex_expansion.claim: Total capital expenditure for the entire Unit 3, excluding land, is estimated between Rs 105 crore and Rs 110 crore.
capex_expansion.quote: I think. It will be around say, it will be anywhere between 105 to 110 cr.

capex_expansion.claim: Capital expenditure for Phase 2 of Unit 3 is expected to be around Rs 55 crore to Rs 60 crore, excluding land.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2. Correct. Yes, sir, it is around 55 to 60 crore, except the value of land.

margins_costs.claim: Trading activities carry a margin of 4-5%.
margins_costs.quote: And about the trading margins, I think we have said it earlier as well. Trading margins are 4-5%, as compared to the, blended profit margins that what you are seeing in the phase of the profit and loss account.

margins_costs.claim: Nominal price increases in imported wood pulp raw material have been passed on to customers.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, whatever the, say, nominal increase in the cost, for the import of raw material that is wood pulp has been completely passed on through the customer.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects blended profit margins to increase by 2-3 percentage points as premium products grow.
margins_costs.quote: It will be prudent enough to assume going ahead, as we are going ahead with more premium range of products, so it is prudent enough to assume that the blended profit margins are going to increase by, say, at least 2-3 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 products consist of premium excipients which command higher margins compared to standard MCC.
margins_costs.quote: Phase one will be in say, it will be a premium range of exhibition product. So margin will be on quote quite higher side as compared to MCC.

margins_costs.claim: The price of Croscarmellose Sodium (CCS) is approximately 3.5 times the price of Microcrystalline Cellulose (MCC).
margins_costs.quote: The price of CC. CCS is around 3.5 times of MCC.

margins_costs.claim: The company's MCC export realization is approximately Rs 230 per kg while domestic realization is around Rs 180 per kg.
margins_costs.quote: Sir. For export markets around 2 30 per kg. And for domestic is around 1 80 per kg.

orders_capacity.claim: Accent Microcell has an order book of approximately 4,000 metric tons across domestic and export markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Taking into account, say, domestic and export market, we have roughly around, 4,000 metric tons orders on hand with us.

orders_capacity.claim: Total sales volume achieved in FY26 was 15,000 metric tons.
The company has an installed capacity of 100 metric tons per month for MCC Spheres.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, say, we have, say, around, 100 metric ton capacity for MCC Spears, and we have… to the extent that we can recall, we have not said that we are the only players in MCC Spears.

orders_capacity.claim: Unit I at Pirana, Ahmedabad operates at 100% capacity utilization with 2,000 MTPA installed capacity.
Unit II at Dahej SEZ operates at 95% capacity utilization with 7,200 MTPA installed capacity.
The company currently has about 4 to 5 months of business orders on hand.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, we have at present about, you can say for 4 to 5 months. We have business on hand, and that's why.

orders_capacity.claim: Unit 1 currently has an installed capacity of 2,400 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: unit one will having a capacity of 2,400 metric ton per annum, as of now.

orders_capacity.claim: Unit 3 Phase 1 will add 2,400 metric tons per annum of premium excipient capacity while Phase 2 will add 12,000 metric tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, sir, phase one at 100% capacity utilization. It will be around 2,400 metric ton per annum and phase 2 will be 12,000 metric ton

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 2 expansion will be funded through a rights issue and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Because Phase 2, Phase 2, we are going to fund it out from right issue, and to a certain extent, internal equals.

capital_allocation.claim: The company does not foresee additional borrowing requirements for working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: And for working capital, we… as of now, we don't foresee any kind of further borrowing requirements.

capital_allocation.claim: Phase 1 and Phase 2 capex plans do not involve fundraising through debt.
capital_allocation.quote: Sir, for, Phase 1 and Phase 2, we have not, yet planned any kind of an, say, fundraising through debt, because it will be, say, partially funded out of internet growth, and, balance will be from right issue.

capital_allocation.claim: The company raised around Rs 40 crore via a rights issue to help fund Phase 2, which has a total cost of Rs 55 crore to Rs 60 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Apart from that. Just to be clear for the fund raising that what you have done for the right issue. It is around 40 crores, and the total cost of phase 2 will be around roughly between 55 to 60 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: Land adjacent to the Pirana plant was purchased from related parties to build warehouse storage.
capital_allocation.quote: Sir, land was purchased from the parties that you stated for which due to the lack of the say inventory, for which inventory storage was required.

risks_headwinds.claim: Phase 1 was delayed due to abnormal monsoons and regulatory licensing requirements for greenfield status.
risks_headwinds.quote: The delay in Phase 1 was, primarily due to two reasons, two back-to-back abnormal monsoons, and, certain licensing work, read with, say, regulatory approvals that was required, being, project treated as, greenfield.

risks_headwinds.claim: An exceptional cost impact from new labor codes was recognized during the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: And in addition to OBO, there was an, say, kind of an exceptional item in the current year as well, wherein the, huge impact of the labor code was also taken by us.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions caused transit time delays without impacting prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sir in this the situation is that due to geopolitical tension there is no fluctuation in prices. Whatever delay there is and whatever challenges there are they are related to transit time to the extent what you have understood so far.

risks_headwinds.claim: Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacted on-site execution activities for Unit-III.
risks_headwinds.quote: Two consecutive abnormal monsoon seasons impacting on-site execution activities

risks_headwinds.claim: Obtaining required regulatory approvals involved extended liaisoning timelines.
risks_headwinds.quote: Extended liaisoning timelines for obtaining the required regulatory approvals

risks_headwinds.claim: Debtor days increased because the company offered extended payment terms to onboard Indian pharmaceutical MNCs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sir, that data needs to be read with, the say, certain percentage decrease in the export sales as well, because we have started targeting Indian MNCs wherein to enter or to have a competitive edge.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that there is currently no clarity regarding potential tariffs on the pharmaceutical sector.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sir, as of now, to the extent would you understand? There is no clarity regarding tariff for the Pharma sector.

management_commitments.claim: Phase 3 expansion is expected to start in 2028 after achieving full capacity in Phase 2.
management_commitments.quote: Almost in 2028 will start the Phase 3.

management_commitments.claim: Commercial production at Phase 2 is expected to go live in March 2027.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, Phase 2, say, it will be premature for me to give any kind of an exact deadline, but as of now, we are expecting it to go live in the month of, March 27.

management_commitments.claim: Working capital days and receivable stretch are expected to normalize by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, if not by, H1 of financial year 27, surely by, say, end of financial 27, it will be taken care of.

management_commitments.claim: Accent Microcell projects ₹70 crore in revenue from Unit-III in Year 1.
Management expects the company to achieve a 15% to 20% CAGR over the next 3 to 5 years.
management_commitments.quote: at least say 15 to 20% CAGR for next 3 to 5 years. We are expecting.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Unit 3 Phase 1 to be commercialized by late October or early November 2025.
management_commitments.quote: By say, quarter 3 of the current financial year. So anywhere between, say by the end of October or in the 1st couple of weeks of November.

management_commitments.claim: Trial runs for Phase 2 of Unit 3 are scheduled to commence in July 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Sir, trial run will commence from say, July 26, as I was stated earlier.
